title: Two successor hand-offs on the P104 word: conditional κ 0.0030428242
body:
Adds `research/p104-two-handoffs/`: two successor hand-offs on PR5551's P104 word, conditional complete kappa **.0030428242** (+1.29e-6 over #5551's .0030415312).

**Conditional on** (a) the five framework assumptions retained by #5544/#5545/#5551; (b) #5551's validity (unreproduced at the time of writing); (c) admissibility of a fresh helper starting at a non-canonical mid frame. For (c), "Variant A" (helpers start at frames 608/613) passes the unmodified PR5545 `local.py`; the canonical-start rule exists only in the #4610 compact-width verifier. No independent human or proof-kernel acceptance is claimed; the selected record is unchanged.

**Mechanism.** Helpers 473 (event 13725) and 531 (event 13941) end their first rank-1 climb at a dim-2 frame and then idle, with no other register holding their symbol. Following the successor hand-off of #5472, the rest of each helper's life moves to a fresh helper starting at that frame (8 -> 1+7, 7 -> 1+6). Pure rename: same 25,310 events, no new ADD, identical paid profile; productive fields 12,814 -> 12,850. By subadditivity the concave moment drops at all 18 calls.

**Verify:** `research/p104-two-handoffs/verify.sh` (stdlib, Python 3.12). It regenerates the word from #5551's pinned word, checks `local.py`/`pricing.py` are literal-only edits (735->737, 743->745, 12814->12850, kappa constants; see `LITERAL-CHANGES.diff`), replays scalar/native/physical caller, and checks all 54 strict + 4 functional outer checks and the exact crossing interval (76070606559/25000000000000, 304282426237/100000000000000), for both the hand-off word and Variant A.

**Independent audit:** an internal AI audit (separate read-only Claude agent, own builder and pipeline) reproduced the word byte-for-byte and the crossing; it rated mid-frame-start legality as unresolved, hence the conditional claim.

Builds on #5551 (thu-nmrc), the successor hand-off pattern of #5472 (GamingPuzzled), and the P104 word line of #5544/#5545 (aliromman; lineage PR2305/2152/2219).
